thread:
Ava (Eng): hey @people-ops — quick heads up, i'm submitting an accommodation request for motion/middle-ear sensitivity. construction in the open area has made the space really rough for me (dizziness after long exposure). low-effort ask: quiet desk, fewer pair-programming blocks for ~4–6 weeks, and approval to work async on a couple tickets. also wondering if we can pause any calibration conversations this cycle while i get stabilized. happy to share a doctor's note if needed. thanks 🙏

Maya (People Ops): thanks for flagging this, Ava — really sorry you're dealing with that. can you DM the accommodations intake form or use the portal? https://intranet.redwood/accommodations. we can start with temporary adjustments immediately while we process the form. pausing calibration is possible but we'll need manager sign-off.

Ava (Eng): filing now — i just uploaded a short note from my clinician to the portal. form says expected duration field, i put 6 weeks for now.

Raj (Eng Manager): thanks for raising this, @Ava. i'll reduce your scheduled pair blocks and move you off rotation for the next 2 sprints. we can reassign the on-call pairing and async you on reviews. @Sofia can you confirm what we need to sign off on the calibration pause?

Sofia (People Ops): got the intake and note. next steps: intake call to confirm reasonable adjustments, optional medical documentation is fine (you already uploaded), and manager sign-off to implement changes. typical immediate supports: a quiet desk or private room booking, reimbursement for noise-cancelling headphones up to $250, and exemption from non-essential pair sessions. we can also mark the performance calibration as "deferred for cause" if the manager requests and documents the reason — that prevents negative inferences. i can schedule a 20m intake tomorrow at 11:00 PT. does that work?

Ava (Eng): 11:00 PT works for me, thank you so much :heart:

PeopleOpsBot: New accommodation intake created by @Ava — case #AC-2026-145. Intake meeting scheduled by Sofia for 2026-03-24 11:00 PT.

Maya (People Ops): quick policy note: if the team requests a calibration pause, we need (1) manager rationale in writing, (2) employee consent, and (3) a plan/criteria for when calibration resumes. we record this in the HR system and flag the employee record so reviewers don't treat the pause as a gap. i'll prep a template manager note.

Raj (Eng Manager): i'll draft the manager rationale and post it to the private HR intake thread; i'll also confirm coverage plans. i'm moving the pair rotation to Liam for the next two sprints.

Liam: got it, can pick up the Wed/Thu pair sessions. ping me if you want any context on the tickets.

Ava (Eng): thank you everyone, appreciate the quick triage. i'll join the intake call tomorrow.

Sofia (People Ops): filing follow-up after intake — will include a checklist: accommodations log, manager sign-off, date to review (4 weeks), and procurement link for headphone reimbursement. we'll keep this private and only share with necessary stakeholders. :white_check_mark:
